message.content: {"summary":"Lane departure warning / multipurpose camera internal failure (U3000-49) disables multiple Honda Sensing systems; DTC returns after clearing.","group":"electrical/electronic","symptoms":["multipurpose camera internal failure","multiple Honda Sensing safety and driver-assistance systems become unavailable","dashboard warnings for ACC, LKAS, CMBS, Road Departure Mitigation, and related safety systems","DTC U3000-49 returns after being cleared"],"conditions":["after service"],"fault_codes":["U3000-49"],"safety_relevant":true,"missing_info":[],"clues":[{"kind":"fault_code","quote":"DTC U3000-49, Multipurpose Camera Internal Failure"},{"kind":"symptom","quote":"The failure causes multiple Honda Sensing safety and driver-assistance systems to become unavailable"},{"kind":"symptom","quote":"produces multiple dashboard warnings, including Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC), Lane Keeping Assist System (LKAS), Collision Mitigation Braking System (CMBS), Road Departure Mitigation, and related safety-system warnings"},{"kind":"condition","quote":"The Honda technician cleared the DTC, but it returned shortly afterward."},{"kind":"safety","quote":"My safety concern is that an internal failure of a single multipurpose camera can simultaneously disable multiple collision-avoidance, lane-assistance, and driver-assistance systems."},{"kind":"component_group","quote":"multipurpose camera"},{"kind":"other","quote":"The vehicle has not yet been repaired."}]}
